description: Get the Git tree of a repository. With recursive=true, returns the complete file tree in a single response (subject to the server's tree-endpoint size cap); use this when you need all paths at once. With recursive=false (default), returns only the top-level entries of the tree. page and limit (default 1000) select one page of those entries, and the response carries has_next to say whether more entries follow.

recursive.description: Return the complete file tree in one response (subject to server cap); default false returns top-level entries only

name: get_repo_tree
